newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz closes MBT sale to SKW.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz closes MBT sale to SKW.

text.p: Sandoz AG said it had finalised an agreement announced in August to sell its Master Builders Technologies to SKW Trostberg AG, a unit of VIAG Group.
The sale was finalised at the previously agreed price of 1.3 billion Swiss francs.

"Announced on August 26, 1996, the agreement has been approved by the antitrust authorities in major countries. The new SKW-MBT group is expected to generate sales of over 2.0 billion Swiss francs in 1997 and will employ a workforce of some 6,500 in over 40 countries," Sandoz said in a statement.
It said that the completion of the divestiture "underlines the momentum of Sandoz' strategic focus" in preparation for merging with Ciba-Geigy AG to form Novartis. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
